get_pricing_purchase.label: Get Pricing — surface the DME purchase price

elseWrites.search.pricing.purchasePriceNote: No purchase price returned. Two things must both be true before the pricing engine will quote a purchase: the Modifier must be NU (this line is billed RR, a rental), and the Billed amount in this section must be 100000 so the quote is not capped at the billed charge. Set both, then click Get Pricing again.

writes.search.pricing.purchasePriceNote: Purchase price for E0601 is $500.00. At a rental of $50.00 a month, the plan buys this equipment outright after 10 rentals — that count is what the Limited Liability end date has to capture.

open_prior_claim.label: Open claim detail — the history claim

submit_ll_record.label: Submit — create the SPI-CLM Limited Liability record

elseWrites.search.limitedLiability.addItem.submitNo: The record was not created. Every required field must be set before Submit will create it: LL type SPI, Sub type code CLM, Crosswalk No, the Effective date (the first rental allowed), the End date (the expected last rental), the diagnosis code from Claim Header → DX 1 in both Dx from and Dx to, and the procedure code from Claim Lines in both Proc from and Proc to. Check each one and Submit again.

writes.search.limitedLiability.resultsNote: 1 active record found. The SPI-CLM Limited Liability record is now on file and caps this rental at the expected last rental month.
writes.search.limitedLiability.addItem.submitNo: SPI-CLM record created. The claim can now be paid — the rental is capped at 10/01/2026, the tenth and last rental month.
